name: hasdata
description: Turn public web pages into structured JSON from inside Cursor. One hosted MCP server covers Google, Bing, Amazon, Walmart, Maps, Zillow, Airbnb, TikTok, YouTube and more, with a rule per site that tells the agent where each payload keeps its fields.
